text: It’s like when you try to convince a young child that he’s safe by sticking a sticky note on the fridge in your best handwriting saying “You’re safe with me.” The problem is kids, no matter how young, have had plenty of experience with grownups who say things like that and then don’t do shit. If push comes to shove, I’m packing a bag and leaving whoever it is that I’m not safe with. Right now, I’m just opening my mail and glancing at my bank account with one eye shut.
